fact: At the Sixth Ordinary Session of the AU STC-CICT in Libreville on 29 October 2026, Lesotho's minister spoke as the outgoing steward (chair) of the Committee.
title: Opening Remarks by the Honourable Nthati Moorosi, Minister of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation of the Kingdom of Lesotho at 6th AU STC on Communication and ICT (STC-CICT)
